_doctrine: v2 fieldsets are not the Universal Inventory Schema. They are a thin, practical subset shaped to become it.

truck.preamble: You are identifying a commercial truck (road-legal, odometer-based) for a commercial equipment marketplace.

fields.label: Make
fields.question: What make is the truck?
fields.prompt_rule: Read the visible make from decals, badges, or the grille. Do not infer make from body style or paint.

fields.label: Model
fields.question: What model is the truck?
fields.prompt_rule: Read the visible model from badges, decals, or a legible model plate. Do not infer model from styling generation.

fields.label: Year
fields.question: What model year is the truck?
fields.prompt_rule: Only propose year from a VIN decode (when a VIN is present and the year digit is unambiguous), a data plate, a window sticker, or a title photo. Do not infer year from body generation or appearance.

fields.label: Mileage
fields.question: What is the odometer reading?
fields.prompt_rule: Only propose mileage from a legibly visible odometer or dash display. Never estimate mileage from age or condition.

fields.label: Engine
fields.question: What engine is installed?
fields.prompt_rule: Read engine identification from a visible valve-cover label, an under-hood plate, or a data placard. Do not infer engine from truck model number.

fields.label: Fuel
fields.question: What fuel type does the truck use?
fields.prompt_rule: Diesel is the category default; when proposing it as a default, the reason must state 'Diesel — category default, not visually confirmed'. A visible fuel/electric indicator OVERRIDES the default.

fields.label: VIN
fields.question: What is the VIN?
fields.prompt_rule: Only propose a VIN if legibly readable from a door-jamb sticker, dashboard placard, or title photo. Do not guess partial characters.

fields.label: Cab Type
fields.question: What cab configuration does the truck have?

human_only.label: GVWR
human_only.question: What is the GVWR rating?
human_only.ai_review_flag: Check the door-jamb sticker or data plate for GVWR — not reliably photo-derivable.

human_only.label: Axle Configuration
human_only.question: Confirm the axle configuration (tag/pusher axles, spread, lift axles).
human_only.ai_review_flag: Physical inspection or seller-confirmed spec — not reliably photo-derivable.

construction_equipment.preamble: You are identifying construction equipment (hours-based) for a commercial equipment marketplace.

fields.label: Make
fields.question: What make is the machine?
fields.prompt_rule: Read the visible make from decals, badges, or a legible data plate. Do not infer make from color or shape.

fields.label: Model
fields.question: What model is the machine?
fields.prompt_rule: Read the visible model from decals, badges, or a data plate. Do not infer model from styling generation.

fields.label: Year
fields.question: What model year is the machine?
fields.prompt_rule: Only propose year from a VIN/serial decode (when a VIN or serial plate is present and the year digit is unambiguous), a data plate, or a title photo. Do not infer year from body generation or appearance.

fields.label: Hours
fields.question: How many hours are shown on the machine?
fields.prompt_rule: Only propose hours if an hour-meter, dash, monitor, or equipment display is legibly visible in a photo. Read the displayed number. Never estimate hours from age, condition, model year, or appearance.

fields.label: Engine
fields.question: What engine is installed?
fields.prompt_rule: Read engine identification from a visible valve-cover label or data plate. Do not infer engine from machine model number.

fields.label: Fuel
fields.question: What fuel type does the machine use?
fields.prompt_rule: Diesel is the category default; when proposing it as a default, the reason must state 'Diesel — category default, not visually confirmed'. A visible fuel/electric indicator OVERRIDES the default.

fields.label: Cab Type
fields.question: What cab type does the machine have?

fields.label: Attachments Included
fields.question: What attachments are visible in the photos?
fields.prompt_rule: List only attachments that are visibly present in a photo. Do not list attachments based on model-typical configuration.

human_only.label: Operating Weight
human_only.question: What is the operating weight?
human_only.ai_review_flag: Check the data plate for operating weight — not reliably photo-derivable.

human_only.label: Reach / Capacity
human_only.question: What is the reach, dig depth, or lift capacity?
human_only.ai_review_flag: Confirm reach or lift capacity from the seller or manufacturer spec sheet — not reliably photo-derivable.

trailer.preamble: You are identifying a trailer for a commercial equipment marketplace.

fields.label: Make
fields.question: What make is the trailer?
fields.prompt_rule: Read the visible make from decals, a data plate, or a manufacturer badge. Do not infer make from styling.

fields.label: Model
fields.question: What model is the trailer?
fields.prompt_rule: Read the visible model from decals or a data plate. Do not infer model from body shape.

fields.label: Year
fields.question: What model year is the trailer?
fields.prompt_rule: Only propose year from a VIN decode (when a VIN is present and the year digit is unambiguous), a data plate, or a title photo. Do not infer year from body generation or appearance.

fields.label: VIN
fields.question: What is the trailer VIN?
fields.prompt_rule: Only propose a VIN if legibly readable from a data plate, frame stamp, or title photo. Do not guess partial characters.

fields.label: Length
fields.question: What is the trailer length?
fields.prompt_rule: Only propose length if legibly visible on a data plate or manufacturer label. Do not estimate length from photos.

fields.label: Axle Count
fields.question: How many axles does the trailer have?
fields.prompt_rule: Count visible axles from a side profile. Do not include lifted or spare axles obscured from view.

fields.label: Deck Type
fields.question: What deck type does the trailer have?

fields.label: Reefer Unit Present
fields.question: Is a refrigeration unit installed?
fields.prompt_rule: Return 'Yes' only if a visible reefer unit (Thermo King, Carrier, or similar) is mounted at the nose of the trailer. Return 'No' if the trailer is a dry-van or other non-refrigerated shape. Do not propose reefer operating hours (deferred to component model).

human_only.label: GVWR
human_only.question: What is the GVWR rating?
human_only.ai_review_flag: Check the data plate for GVWR — not reliably photo-derivable.

human_only.label: Tire Condition
human_only.question: What is the tire condition?
human_only.ai_review_flag: Physical inspection required — tread depth and sidewall condition are not reliably photo-derivable.
